{{Quote|Traitor!|The Force Hound, to Xesh|<ref name="War 1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force War'' 1]]</ref>}}
A '''Force Hound''' served the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] during the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Invasion of the Tython system|invasion]] of the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]]. Garbed in dark [[Robe/Legends|robes]] and wearing a [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] with a triangular red [[Eye/Legends|eyepiece]], the [[Force Hound]] used a purple-bladed [[Forcesaber]] in combat. In [[25,792 BBY]], the Force Hound rode a winged beast in the [[Battle of Shikaakwa]] and attacked the [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Shae Koda]]. However, Koda channeled the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and slew the Hound's mount, sending her assailant crashing to the ground. When the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] warrior attempted to duel the former Hound [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] after surviving the crash, Xesh quickly ended his enemy's life with a Forcesaber thrust through the heart.<ref name="War 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Force Hound appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force War'' 1]],<ref name="War 1" /> which was released on [[November 20]], [[2013]].<ref name="PublishingDate">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/22-793/Star-Wars-Dawn-of-the-Jedi-Force-War-1|text=Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi—Force War #1}}</ref> The issue was scripted by [[John Ostrander]] with art by [[Jan Duursema]], the latter of whom was also credited with conceiving the story alongside Ostrander. The Hound's [[Species/Legends|species]] and [[Gender/Legends|gender]] were not revealed, and neither was the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] letter that the Hound was named after and [[Tattoo/Legends|tattooed]] with.<ref name="War 1" />
